resources.string: Add up to %1$d distinct public HTTPS SearXNG services. No instances are configured by default. Choose JSON video candidates or HTML web candidates explicitly; confirm permitted use with the operator.
When you explicitly search, enabled service operators and their upstream search engines receive your query. Operators may log it. Only configure services you trust and are permitted to use.
SafeSearch capability is unknown for these sources. Requests with SafeSearch enabled are rejected without sending a query; your requested SafeSearch setting remains unchanged.
Adding, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting or clearing instances never starts a search. Existing candidates and source progress become invalid; explicitly search again to continue.
Local source configuration has not been read.
Local source configuration is invalid, duplicates a service, or uses an unsupported version. The original file is preserved and all SearXNG sources are disabled.
Source configuration cannot be reliably read or written. Original data is preserved and all SearXNG sources are disabled.
This deletes every configured instance and invalidates old candidates and source progress. The instance list will be empty. It does not start a search.

Enter a complete public HTTPS URL ending in /search, including a base path if needed. Public domain names only; no account, password, query, fragment, port, IP literal or local address. URL-encoded paths and repeated slashes are not supported.

HTML results are ordinary web candidates awaiting validation, not verified videos. JSON failures never switch to HTML automatically. A working web page does not establish permission to use the service.
When you explicitly search, this service operator and its upstream search engines receive your query. The operator may log it. The endpoint address is stored locally as functional configuration.
I agree to send queries to this service and its upstream engines, and understand that the operator may log them.
SafeSearch capability is unknown; requests with SafeSearch enabled are rejected. Saving does not change SafeSearch or send or repeat a query.
This service is already configured. A service cannot be added again under another path or as a separate JSON or HTML instance.
Configuration changed. Close and reopen this dialog.
Configured does not mean verified. Saving does not probe the service or verify its availability, permission to use it, or compatibility.
Enabling an instance makes it eligible for an explicit search. All instances share the same per-search budget, so some enabled instances may not be visited.
No instances added. Add a permitted SearXNG service to get started.
The %1$d-instance limit is reached. Delete an instance before adding another.
Choose a candidate format explicitly before saving this new instance.
Delete %1$s from the instance list? This disables and removes the instance, invalidates old candidates and source progress, and does not start a search.
